items.title: back east
items.explanation: 从美国西部或中部的视角指美国东部；back 带有回望来处或既有地域视角的意味，通常不译为“回到东部”。
items.source: Old-timers used it to describe a man who had just arrived from one of the big cities back east
items.example: She grew up back east but now lives in Arizona.

items.title: continue on：继续前行
items.explanation: continue on 表示沿当前路线继续前行；on 强调向前延续，但在部分语境中只用 continue 也足够。
items.source: A green light on a traffic signal means your car can continue on
items.example: Continue on for another two miles.

items.title: go out with someone：与某人约会
items.explanation: go out with someone 在恋爱语境中表示与某人约会或谈恋爱，不只是一起外出；上下文决定其含义。
items.source: A young man may suffer from the green-eyed monster if his girlfriend begins going out with someone else
items.example: Is she going out with Daniel?

items.title: old-timers
items.explanation: 指在某地生活很久、熟悉当地旧事和传统的人；语气较口语，不只是泛指老人。
items.source: Old-timers used it to describe a man who had just arrived from one of the big cities back east
items.example: The old-timers still remember when this road was unpaved.

items.title: review 的常见搭配
items.explanation: 高频搭配包括 review notes（复习笔记）、review a document（审查文件）、write a review（写评论）和 under review（正在审查中）。
items.example: The application is still under review.
